name: Perguruan Islam Al-Izhar Pondok Labu
address: Jl. RS Fatmawati Kav.49, Pondok Labu, Cilandak, Jakarta Selatan

period.id: Pendaftaran 3–17 November 2026 (pukul 14.30 WIB): KB, TK, SD untuk internal; SMP dan SMA untuk internal (reguler), eksternal (early bird, ditutup bila kuota penuh), dan beasiswa.
period.en: Registration 3–17 November 2026 (14:30 WIB): KB, TK and SD for internal applicants; SMP and SMA for internal (regular), external (early bird, closes when full) and scholarship tracks.

steps.id: Transfer biaya pendaftaran ke rekening sekolah dan unggah bukti di akun PSB.
steps.en: Transfer the registration fee to the school account and upload proof in your PSB account.

steps.id: Ikuti seleksi dan wawancara orang tua sesuai jadwal.
steps.en: Attend the selection and parent interview on schedule.

steps.id: Pengumuman lewat email orang tua, lalu lunasi biaya pendidikan.
steps.en: Results by email to parents, then pay the education fees.

test.id: Seleksi PSB dan wawancara orang tua.

notes.id: Besaran biaya tidak dicantumkan di halaman.
notes.en: Fee amounts are not shown on the page.
